auditScope: methodological coercion, self-attestation, and exact parse-to-admission flow for G3/B3 research profiles

findings.evidence: Before remediation the provider schema required all ten completed-question fields and all ten certificate bindings even when certificationStatus was NO_SAFE_SITE. Minimal abstention failed Zod parsing and therefore could not reach raw-candidate observation.
findings.remediation: The provider-visible surface remains one object and uses no anyOf/oneOf. Only siteCertificate and its certificationStatus are unconditionally required. A conditional server refinement admits status+nonblank abstentionReason only for NO_SAFE_SITE, rejects any fabricated binding or question shell, and revalidates CERTIFIED against the original complete schema.
findings.proof: One valid minimal abstention, five hostile abstentions, ten deleted completed-question fields, and ten deleted certificate bindings are checked dynamically. The exact production response test proves a minimal abstention is observed once and terminally recorded as parsed_rejected without finalization or shipment.

findings.evidence: The B3 schema requires three literal true values, but the profile adapter never reads seamAudit. It validates exact span/evidence/label/text bindings and distinct declared mechanisms, then serializes the blueprint into blankDesign. The blank postprocessor removes blankDesign before the actual quality validator runs.
deterministicCoverage: duplicated connector at the left boundary
duplicated preposition at the right boundary
duplicated punctuation at the right boundary
additional contextual syntax, polarity, length, and lexical heuristics elsewhere in the blank validators
notDeterministicallyProven: full grammaticality of every arbitrary prefix+option+suffix combination
truth of the declared distractor mechanism
equivalence of the declared correct intent
mutual exclusivity and decisive semantic exclusion
overall item validity and craft quality
findings.adversarialProof: A synchronized B3 ledger with all three seamAudit literals true is accepted by the adapter, but a duplicated final period is independently recomputed as blank-double-punctuation-boundary and rejected by the production quality gate. A second fixture reverses the passage thesis while retaining a clean seam; the adapter accepts it and the seam analyzer returns no finding, demonstrating why semantic adjudication remains necessary.
findings.wordingChange: The prompt now says the server recomputes only named high-confidence boundary signals and explicitly states that seamAudit=true is not server certification of full grammar or semantics.

flow: Zod profile schema is converted to provider JSON Schema and used by the AI SDK structured-output parser.
Parsed raw question candidates are observed before profile adaptation.
G3 NO_SAFE_SITE is terminally rejected by the adapter after observation and before postprocessing.
G3 CERTIFIED is conditionally complete-schema validated, then exact passage and marked-field bindings are checked by the adapter.
B3 exact ledger bindings are checked by the adapter; seamAudit literals are not consulted as evidence.
Production postprocessing reconstructs the actual student surface and removes the internal blankDesign payload.
Production quality validation recomputes high-confidence blank-boundary findings from passageWithBlank and visible options; high findings are blocking errors.
Semantic validity and complete naturalness remain blind-rater/manual adjudication targets.

scopeBoundary.proves: offline schema reachability, fail-closed conditional validation, exact adapter ordering, selected deterministic B3 recomputation, and non-trust of literal seam claims
scopeBoundary.doesNotProve: live provider adherence, G3/B3 quality improvement, semantic correctness of generated questions, or production promotion eligibility
